trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for the other 54, so it is never something to chase on its own: follow the four roadmap stages in order and it unlocks by itself when the last trophy lands. Launch-day reporting agrees the whole list is single-player, with no online trophies and no difficulty setting, which means one careful playthrough is enough. The difficulty (4/10) and time (~200 hours) figures quoted on this page are PowerPyx estimates passed on by KeenGamer and GTA-Zone — treat them as rough guides, not promises.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: One of the first story trophies: finish the Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing and it unlocks on its own — nothing here can be missed. Treat these opening minutes as a warm-up: get comfortable with the controls and switch on progress and collectible notifications in Settings before you start roaming, because the habits you build now pay off across the whole list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1; it may pop a moment after the chapter turns over, which is normal. Before you leave Chapter 1 behind, do the single thing this guide flags in red: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at home (see Positive Mental Attitude). Keep a manual save at the chapter break too — with no mission replay in the game, saves are your only way back.

Chapter 2 is where the duo's toolkit arrives — the partner call, Combat Focus and the Scooter Bros app — so several free-roam trophies (Hot Together, On the Spot, and the paired gym work behind Personal Best) only become possible from here on. Nothing in this chapter can be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long gold. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist — but note it does not demand everything. Launch-day reporting lists it in full for all robberies (including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, and only in part for the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Nothing on it is missable and earlier progress counts. The exact checklist shares are as GTABase reported them on launch day and may be refined as more players finish.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. Launch-day reporting breaks the stunt pool down as 397 in total — stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — with under-bridge flying the fastest way to build the count, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not required. Track the counter under Progress > Activities > Stunts and turn on Stunt Spot map markers. Keep going afterwards: the 100% checklist asks for 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every one of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, a race win of any kind, and a stunt. Most happen naturally on the road to 100%; check Progress > Activities to see which types are still blank and mop those up in stage 4.

trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which quietly makes Gunslinger easier, so do ranges before you grind that trophy. Golds are required in full by the 100% checklist too, so no run here is wasted.

Three games sit on the TV at home and a fourth lives on arcade cabinets around Leonida, so the home TV is the zero-travel option. This also covers the arcade slot of Master of None. trophies.guide: Finish Andy's quest line. His jobs are Lucia-only, begin in Chapter 3 when he texts her an address in Belville, and run as a fixed chain of five missions — the fifth is the one that awards the trophy. The line stays available after the story, so it is safe cleanup material, but starting it in Chapter 3 spreads the work out. Mission names are as GTABase listed them on launch day.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only one on the list. Meditate at all 18 spots until the counter reaches 18; a spot used with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The risk: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation — that moment is gone after Chapter 1. Whether the trophy truly needs that spot was UNCONFIRMED at launch (PowerPyx, via launch-day guides, flagged it only as a possible missable), but every reported platinum run did it, so do it. Note the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so this cannot block A Long Road either way.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason: work the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: scan spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, drawn from the landmark, curiosity and sculpture spots and the No Flusher tags scattered over the map. The 100% checklist asks for exactly this same 100, so every scan is double progress — make scanning a habit from Chapter 1, not a stage-3 grind. trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; finished ones are ticked under Progress > Challenges. Many complete themselves in normal play, and the 100% checklist raises the bar to 70 of 80, so treat 50 as a milestone you pass on the way rather than a target to stop at.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and lose it completely — the trophy counts once you are out of the red heat zone, and it only becomes possible once both characters can travel together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner with hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y. Bank vault robberies always draw 4 stars, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal; a reported reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, which breaks line of sight to cars and helicopters.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while your Wanted Level stays active the whole time — losing the heat between shops breaks the chain. Go in prepared: body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City (opened by Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together and are the reported route. Allow about 30 seconds for the trophy to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Standing by a busy road and scanning passing traffic builds the count quickly. This is only the halfway mark: the 100% checklist wants 200 base models, so keep scanning new shapes whenever traffic changes district.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). The window is only a few seconds, so fill Focus first — eating, drinking or washing up at home tops it up, and Adrenaline reportedly stretches it — then trigger it in a packed fight with an assault rifle. Gang operation crews are the reported targets; police, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not count. Raising your Focus level at shooting ranges first makes this noticeably easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet that is docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at VCIA — jets parked out on the open airfield do not count — back it out, take off and put roughly a kilometre between you and the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the reported easy entries: through the airfield fence, then the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

Steal one from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks sit at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy wanted response on the way out; the tank itself is the safest seat in the county while you work.

Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 hand you the Snap Gun: use it on the store's locked back door — kicking the door in trips the alarm and voids the attempt — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the reported reliable target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is...: follow a security van to its bank and get inside while the vault stands open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Every vault draws 4 stars — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the 8 vaults satisfy the trophy, but 100% wants all 8 and each reportedly pays up to $205,000; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

The fast way is from the air: borrow a plane and sweep every remaining dark patch in a couple of passes late in the game, when the whole map is open and fast aircraft are easy to find. The 52-area count is from the official list's own reporting in the kit; treat the count as reported — the requirement, a fully revealed map, is the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is a robbery in a joke's clothing. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs) — and the trophy pops once you lose the police. The three valuables do not have to fall in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to respawn, so try to clear it in one run.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (check Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along — training one character reportedly trains the other too — and after the story you can also train at home. It is a steady grind rather than a trick: slot gym visits into your roaming from Chapter 2 onward and it lands long before the cleanup.

trophies.guide: Reach 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the count PlayStation itself tracks for this trophy. Most players arrive without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI if you want to watch it climb. One warning from launch-day guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable criminal profile, because that one is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD. The official description — "Second time's the charm" — points at succeeding at something on a second attempt, and at launch no source below had pinned down which activity, event or failure it counts. Do not burn hours guessing: it is a 5-point bronze that reported platinum runs picked up along the way, so play normally, retry the things you fail (races, challenges, robberies), and check back once sourced guides confirm the trigger. trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts; it is a running total, not a single sale. The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) earns you the Dye Pack Jammer; after that, rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills on to fences — Yasmani in Vice City reportedly pays the most. The robberies you already owe the 100% checklist carry most of this total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total — a running counter over every purchase, not one spree. Guns, car modifications and tattoos burn through it fastest. Buy what your platinum run actually needs (armor, ammo, garage cars, mods) and check the counter late in stage 3; top it up in stage 4 only if it is still short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. They are sold through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after Daily Driver in Chapter 2, and launch-day reporting puts the set at roughly $160,000 in total; the 4 garages the story hands you do not count toward the 8. Buy them as your robbery income lands — you need the space anyway for On the Spot's registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gives you the app: take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. Early on he only accepts cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so feed it cheap cars and bikes.
